messages.subject: Re: "Error: Unknown Parameter: mult" when trying to use Deducer to plot anything
parts:
Richard,

There was recently a new version of ggplot2 released that had a number of API changes requiring non-trivial changes in Deducer. I’ve submitted an updated version to CRAN, which should be pushed out in the next few days.

Best,
Ian


On Dec 22, 2015, at 1:44 PM, Richard Anderson <rander...@gmail.com> wrote:


When I try to use Deducer to generate any kind of data plot, I get the error -- Error: Unknown Parameter: mult

I am using R 3.2.3. on Windows 7. Is the problem that Deducer is not fully compatible with the current R? Something else?

--
